title: 3D generation gets a JSON request body
summary:
JSON-based 3D generation and Grok transcription joined a day of more predictable model routing and clearer API guidance.

POST /3d/{prompt} now accepts a validated JSON body with a model, reference image URL or URL array, resolution, and integer seed. Trellis 2 defaults to low resolution, with medium and high options. Unlike the existing GET route, repeated POST requests regenerate rather than using the URL-based media cache.

The paid-only `grok-transcribe` model was added with text, JSON, verbose JSON, and diarized JSON output, including word timestamps and speaker-labeled segments. Model listings now identify the transcription endpoint for Whisper, Scribe, and Universal models, while mismatched speech and transcription requests return a 400 before reaching a provider.

Text responses now report the canonical model that handled a request in `x-model-used`, including streams and fallback targets. Slow text providers get a longer request allowance and a structured timeout. FLUX no longer switches providers when its worker pool is unavailable, and GPT Image no longer retries generation in another region after an error, avoiding possible duplicate images.

highlights.title: 3D requests in JSON
highlights.text: Send `POST /3d/{prompt}` with a model, reference image URLs, resolution, and seed in a JSON body. POST requests regenerate rather than using the URL-based media cache. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Grok Transcribe joins audio
highlights.text: Transcribe audio with the paid-only `grok-transcribe` model, with options for word timestamps and speaker-labeled segments. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok-transcribe).
